name: iMessage Sync
summary: Every night, your whole iMessage history becomes a folder people and AIs can read: Markdown per person and per day, a searchable database, and photos, videos and PDFs sorted and shrunk.
story: Messages hides your conversations in a database no other app can open and quietly offloads old photos. iMessage Sync copies everything out every night and never forgets, even after you clean up Messages. It heals itself: catches up after sleep, retries with backoff, and a doctor command tells you exactly what to fix.

launcher.short: Nightly archive of every conversation, for people and AIs
launcher.long: Every night: all conversations to Markdown + a searchable SQLite db, attachments sorted by type (photos/videos/PDFs/audio) and shrunk. Self-healing schedule, dashboard, doctor, per-person pipelines.
